coordinate_rule: all layers use the same exact canvas and integer origin; runtime zero-angle weapons face down

layer_definitions.base: non-rotating chassis, hull, legs or foundation
layer_definitions.mount: optional ring, shoulder or hinge below the rotating weapon
layer_definitions.weapon: rotating turret, arm, sensor head or launcher
layer_definitions.muzzle: short registered effect sequence; not baked into idle
layer_definitions.damage_overlay: registered physical damage, never a whole-sprite colour wash

animation_minimums.turret_rotation: continuous engine rotation around declared integer pivot
